# Optics

The goal of `Optics` is to provide a standardized toolkit for evaluating the performance of machine learning models on optical survey data.

## Installation

You can install the development version of Optics from [GitHub](https://github.com/NOAA-NMFS-SWFSC/Optics) with:

``` r
# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("NOAA-NMFS-SWFSC/Optics")
```
